responsibilities: Design and implement data models and data products in SAP Datasphere
Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA and other data sources
Integrate SAP data into broader cloud data platforms like Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
Develop analytical datasets for SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and Power BI
Ensure high data quality, consistency, and governance across SAP and enterprise data
Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure high data quality, consistency, and governance across SAP and enterprise data
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality, consistency, governance and 'reliable, business-ready products' set the tone, and there is no speed language.
evidence.domain_risk: facilitate reporting, planning, and advanced analytics across the organization
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The client is consumer goods and the data feeds internal reporting and planning, with no regulatory or financial-reporting language in the responsibilities.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Integrate SAP data into broader cloud data platforms like Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Existing SAP and cloud platforms are being joined up, a growing data function rather than a first build.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and implement data models and data products in SAP Datasphere
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Most bullets name the exact systems (Datasphere, S/4HANA, SAC, Power BI), with one generic stakeholder line.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: transform complex data into reliable, business-ready products
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role builds data products and datasets for downstream reporting tools across the organisation, a data platform audience.
evidence.autonomy_level: Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: A contracted consultant delivers models and pipelines against stakeholder requirements, with no direction-setting verbs.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: 'Advanced analytics' is mentioned, but nothing asks for AI tools or AI-facing data work.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure high data quality, consistency, and governance
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality is a responsibility the candidate owns, though no testing tool is named.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability and quality matter but sit behind delivery of models and pipelines.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design and implement data models and data products in SAP Datasphere...Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: New Datasphere models sit beside optimising pipelines and integrating existing platforms.
evidence.loss_aversion: Ensure high data quality, consistency, and governance across SAP and enterprise data — a quality bullet within a delivery-led role.
